# Apple Silicon inference-engine survey

<!-- Generated by inference_engine_advisor.py from assets/inference_engines.json. -->

Reviewed 2026-10-05. 24 pinned projects; 14 method/validation contracts.

Primary-source architecture survey; not a benchmark leaderboard or deployment approval.

All engine measurements remain **not run locally in this survey**. Reading code is not runtime qualification. Exact pins describe the inspected snapshot, not a claim that every feature ships in the latest stable release.

## What to learn, and what would invalidate it

### P0 / phase-metrics

**Bottleneck:** Misleading or incomparable performance reports

Separate process/load, request first-content latency, physical prefill, cached tokens, decode and end-to-end time; disclose observed model width.

**Correctness gate:** Monotonic parent timing; valid token accounting; no heartbeat counted as a token; preserve failure rows.

**Measure:** Cold/warm/partial-prefix runs, p50/p95 latency, aggregate throughput, RSS/Metal/cache/swap separately.

**Rollback:** Reject comparison or keep baseline when artifact, workload, precision, hardware or metric semantics differ.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [MLX-VLM](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/tree/6ecadd767ca1c7c54763289c750dd180d7945037), [dflash-mlx](https://github.com/bstnxbt/dflash-mlx/tree/60803233af4589e18588b9bacbb03880801c828a), [mlx2](https://github.com/pierre427/mlx2/tree/bb031aaafd6438287a32d80512e1573cdaf1fc1b), [MTPLX](https://github.com/youssofal/MTPLX/tree/9882703f3105363ddc37eca9f97aa09a1d387112).

### P0 / memory-admission

**Bottleneck:** Requests or model pools exceed usable memory

Reserve model plus projected KV/state/activation growth and system headroom before admission; bound queues and eviction.

**Correctness gate:** Mixed long/short overload, pinned-model constraints, cancellation releases leases, rejected requests produce explicit errors.

**Measure:** Peak and steady memory, queue time, admission failures, eviction stalls, tail latency.

**Rollback:** Reduce admission or unload safely; never silently reduce context or quantize weights.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [oMLX](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/tree/a435a3736071286fdb2b74f486b3505f23f3c194), [Splash](https://github.com/incoai/splash/tree/35c828c34bf4e3718dc8064c061132db9e018385), [mlx2](https://github.com/pierre427/mlx2/tree/bb031aaafd6438287a32d80512e1573cdaf1fc1b).

### P0 / packaged-runtime

**Bottleneck:** Fragile interpreters and incompatible native kernels

Pin the entire executable/dependency/native-library environment and probe the actual compiled backend capabilities.

**Correctness gate:** Relocatable environment launch, correct ABI/library resolution, no ambient packages; first real workload inside the intended isolation.

**Measure:** Cold load, warm load, compiler/startup work, packaging size and selected/fallback kernel counters.

**Rollback:** Refuse unsupported ABI/device paths and keep a tested runtime; do not broaden sandbox permissions to hide failures.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [LM Studio mlx-engine](https://github.com/lmstudio-ai/mlx-engine/tree/86f20eb48bc79c528f682fabfc0384f799cdea0f), [oMLX](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/tree/a435a3736071286fdb2b74f486b3505f23f3c194), [rMLX](https://github.com/Pushkinist/rMLX/tree/e5d967a5c065c7a602d9e171c7d41ac006b1adcc), [Osaurus vmlx-swift](https://github.com/osaurus-ai/vmlx-swift/tree/2b05d39a6f43c1bc8789112fc92baa426d84c833), [mlx-serve](https://github.com/ddalcu/mlx-serve/tree/c84a5a6321c7bad40c50b2bc50f7a5f4510413ab).

### P0 / protocol-conformance

**Bottleneck:** Compatible endpoints behave differently for real clients

Test exact tool/reasoning/template, usage, stop, cancellation and error semantics with versioned client transcripts.

**Correctness gate:** Malformed tools fail; unsupported controls fail explicitly; disconnect halts work; no hidden template/sampling change.

**Measure:** First-content latency, successful tool round trips, stream errors and cancellation cleanup.

**Rollback:** Fall back to a declared supported route or return an explicit unsupported error.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [vllm-mlx](https://github.com/waybarrios/vllm-mlx/tree/80e7fdec7e8641c8f81b01ece2d7cc256348b76f), [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX/tree/c55b6edfc53bb5cbcc1fe423bf75dcc7bb5dd8cc), [mlx2](https://github.com/pierre427/mlx2/tree/bb031aaafd6438287a32d80512e1573cdaf1fc1b), [mlx-serve](https://github.com/ddalcu/mlx-serve/tree/c84a5a6321c7bad40c50b2bc50f7a5f4510413ab), [MTPLX](https://github.com/youssofal/MTPLX/tree/9882703f3105363ddc37eca9f97aa09a1d387112).

### P1 / stateful-cache

**Bottleneck:** Repeated prompts recompute or state restore is unsafe

Use topology-specific immutable checkpoints, copy-on-write and leases; recurrent state cannot be reconstructed by slicing ordinary KV.

**Correctness gate:** Cold-vs-warm next-token/logit and multi-turn checks; exact prefix length; rollback; tenant and adapter/media identity mutation tests.

**Measure:** Exact and partial hit rates, restored versus computed tokens, clone bytes and restoration cost.

**Rollback:** Invalidate incompatible/corrupt state and recompute; never reuse partially qualified hybrid state.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [MLX-LM](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/tree/5cfec4cb39deba54210b3ff4d86f2337c7bc10b5), [MLX-VLM](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/tree/6ecadd767ca1c7c54763289c750dd180d7945037), [oMLX](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/tree/a435a3736071286fdb2b74f486b3505f23f3c194), [vMLX](https://github.com/jjang-ai/vmlx/tree/279c59c66dfb76b6d980e356e2c9563e34b26dde), [rMLX](https://github.com/Pushkinist/rMLX/tree/e5d967a5c065c7a602d9e171c7d41ac006b1adcc), [mlx2](https://github.com/pierre427/mlx2/tree/bb031aaafd6438287a32d80512e1573cdaf1fc1b), [dflash-mlx](https://github.com/bstnxbt/dflash-mlx/tree/60803233af4589e18588b9bacbb03880801c828a).

### P1 / chunked-prefill

**Bottleneck:** A long prefill starves ongoing generations

Token-budget chunking interleaves prefill and decoding; continuous batching must expose actual compute widths and safe per-request state.

**Correctness gate:** Unequal lengths, left padding/masks, per-request sampler/stop, cancellation at chunk boundaries, no starvation.

**Measure:** Prefill versus decode latency, p95 inter-token time, observed width, queue depth and aggregate tokens.

**Rollback:** Reduce chunk/concurrency budget or revert to single-request execution when quality or tail latency regresses.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [MLX-LM](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/tree/5cfec4cb39deba54210b3ff4d86f2337c7bc10b5), [MLX-VLM](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/tree/6ecadd767ca1c7c54763289c750dd180d7945037), [vllm-mlx](https://github.com/waybarrios/vllm-mlx/tree/80e7fdec7e8641c8f81b01ece2d7cc256348b76f), [oMLX](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/tree/a435a3736071286fdb2b74f486b3505f23f3c194), [vLLM Metal](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-metal/tree/39255c170616bba3e2010e108d5caeb7e21443db).

### P1 / media-identity

**Bottleneck:** Vision/audio processing is repeated or a text cache aliases media

Separate encoder-output and language-state caches; bind media content and processor/frame/audio settings to exact cache identity.

**Correctness gate:** Same text with changed image/audio/frame order must miss; processor/template/adapter/tenant changes invalidate.

**Measure:** Encoder latency, media bytes, prompt prefill, first-audio and first-text boundaries separately.

**Rollback:** Disable the media cache and re-encode when identity or restored-state qualification is missing.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [MLX-VLM](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/tree/6ecadd767ca1c7c54763289c750dd180d7945037), [mistral.rs](https://github.com/EricLBuehler/mistral.rs/tree/3f2515e9b5adc2ac44949c128c50a13b15721294), [rMLX](https://github.com/Pushkinist/rMLX/tree/e5d967a5c065c7a602d9e171c7d41ac006b1adcc), [Osaurus vmlx-swift](https://github.com/osaurus-ai/vmlx-swift/tree/2b05d39a6f43c1bc8789112fc92baa426d84c833), [MLX-Audio](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-audio/tree/feb25a37b07923bae556e59111995071d66afa0d).

### P2 / tiered-cache

**Bottleneck:** Reusable prefix state exceeds the hot-cache budget

Bound hot RAM and cold SSD stores with explicit format/version, checksums, atomic writes and per-namespace limits.

**Correctness gate:** Interrupted write/restart, checksum failure, partial restore, lease/eviction races, no cross-tenant hits.

**Measure:** SSD reads/writes, restore latency, physical and apparent prefill rates, hot/cold hits and resident state.

**Rollback:** Evict or ignore bad snapshots and recompute; keep model-weight fit and SSD-cache capacity as separate budgets.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [MLX-VLM](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/tree/6ecadd767ca1c7c54763289c750dd180d7945037), [oMLX](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/tree/a435a3736071286fdb2b74f486b3505f23f3c194), [vllm-mlx](https://github.com/waybarrios/vllm-mlx/tree/80e7fdec7e8641c8f81b01ece2d7cc256348b76f), [dflash-mlx](https://github.com/bstnxbt/dflash-mlx/tree/60803233af4589e18588b9bacbb03880801c828a).

### P2 / speculation

**Bottleneck:** Serial target decoding is bandwidth/dispatch bound

Pair exact target/draft artifacts; optimize the verification shape, track acceptance and retain ordinary decode as a selectable baseline.

**Correctness gate:** Greedy and sampled paths separately; residual correction where sampling is claimed; rejected-token KV/GDN rollback; repeated seed/distribution checks.

**Measure:** Accepted tokens per verification, draft/verify/rollback time, depth, context and short-output break-even.

**Rollback:** Disable speculation when total useful progress is slower or any target-quality/state gate fails.

**Approximation classification:** conditional. **Primary sources:** [MTPLX](https://github.com/youssofal/MTPLX/tree/9882703f3105363ddc37eca9f97aa09a1d387112), [dflash-mlx](https://github.com/bstnxbt/dflash-mlx/tree/60803233af4589e18588b9bacbb03880801c828a), [Splash](https://github.com/incoai/splash/tree/35c828c34bf4e3718dc8064c061132db9e018385), [vLLM Metal](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-metal/tree/39255c170616bba3e2010e108d5caeb7e21443db), [mlx2](https://github.com/pierre427/mlx2/tree/bb031aaafd6438287a32d80512e1573cdaf1fc1b).

### P2 / paged-kernels

**Bottleneck:** Attention or small verification matmuls dominate the profile

Use variable-length paged attention and shape/device-specialized fused kernels behind explicit capability guards and a readable reference.

**Correctness gate:** Dtype/layout/mask/group-size/length boundary parity; packaged metallib/ABI checks; safe fallback for unsupported shapes.

**Measure:** Per-phase kernel/launch time, command-buffer/synchronization cost, prefill/decode/verify separately.

**Rollback:** Revert the exact kernel path on parity, unsupported hardware, allocation or tail-latency regression.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [vLLM Metal](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-metal/tree/39255c170616bba3e2010e108d5caeb7e21443db), [Splash](https://github.com/incoai/splash/tree/35c828c34bf4e3718dc8064c061132db9e018385), [mlx-serve](https://github.com/ddalcu/mlx-serve/tree/c84a5a6321c7bad40c50b2bc50f7a5f4510413ab), [MTPLX](https://github.com/youssofal/MTPLX/tree/9882703f3105363ddc37eca9f97aa09a1d387112), [dflash-mlx](https://github.com/bstnxbt/dflash-mlx/tree/60803233af4589e18588b9bacbb03880801c828a).

### P2 / approximation-gates

**Bottleneck:** Lower precision or less computation is presented as free speed

Treat KV/weight quantization, expert reduction, sparse prefill and context compaction as separate task-quality experiments.

**Correctness gate:** Full model/task metrics and long-context tests; distinguish packed resident storage from a codec with a full-precision shadow.

**Measure:** Actual resident bytes including shadows/scales, quality deltas and phase timing at the same output policy.

**Rollback:** Restore precision/expert count/context path if the predeclared task-quality threshold fails.

**Approximation classification:** lossy. **Primary sources:** [rMLX](https://github.com/Pushkinist/rMLX/tree/e5d967a5c065c7a602d9e171c7d41ac006b1adcc), [vllm-mlx](https://github.com/waybarrios/vllm-mlx/tree/80e7fdec7e8641c8f81b01ece2d7cc256348b76f), [vMLX](https://github.com/jjang-ai/vmlx/tree/279c59c66dfb76b6d980e356e2c9563e34b26dde), [MLX-VLM](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/tree/6ecadd767ca1c7c54763289c750dd180d7945037), [mistral.rs](https://github.com/EricLBuehler/mistral.rs/tree/3f2515e9b5adc2ac44949c128c50a13b15721294).

### P3 / expert-streaming

**Bottleneck:** Sparse model weights exceed memory but few experts are active

Stream only required expert/table data, overlap bounded I/O, and preserve exact router selections.

**Correctness gate:** Match resident execution token/logit/router results; cold SSD stalls and disk failure must fail safely.

**Measure:** SSD bandwidth, page faults, cold/warm expert locality, resident buffers and sustained decode.

**Rollback:** Use a smaller model or resident path when I/O stalls or memory headroom fails; never claim streaming eliminates OOM risk.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [Flash-MoE](https://github.com/danveloper/flash-moe/tree/3601d41882a346d85041f7955c66429d248e8cd9), [MTPLX](https://github.com/youssofal/MTPLX/tree/9882703f3105363ddc37eca9f97aa09a1d387112).

### P3 / topology-routing

**Bottleneck:** A model requires multiple Macs or heterogeneous memory

Choose tensor versus pipeline partitioning from measured compute/link budgets rather than aggregate RAM alone.

**Correctness gate:** Shard identity, full-model parity, rank failure/recovery and collective synchronization.

**Measure:** Per-rank time, link latency/bandwidth, serial and concurrent latency, total energy and cost.

**Rollback:** Return to a validated smaller topology or single-host model when communication dominates.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [exo](https://github.com/exo-explore/exo/tree/21a54c5ea0230a3bec1e1a786d200126c7e34ec6), [oMLX](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/tree/a435a3736071286fdb2b74f486b3505f23f3c194).

### P1 / audio-metrics

**Bottleneck:** Text metrics hide unusable audio latency or quality

Treat speech as a pipeline: frontend, acoustic model, codec/vocoder, chunk flush and playback lead time.

**Correctness gate:** WER/CER where appropriate, speaker/prosody fidelity, continuity across chunks, cancellation and long-form drift.

**Measure:** First-audio latency; real-time factor defined as compute seconds divided by generated audio seconds; peak memory and underruns.

**Rollback:** Keep the prior audio pipeline if task or continuity gates regress even when text generation speeds improve.

**Approximation classification:** none. **Primary sources:** [MLX-Audio](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-audio/tree/feb25a37b07923bae556e59111995071d66afa0d), [MLX Omni Server](https://github.com/madroidmaq/mlx-omni-server/tree/4f8e9ef623808b876d2fd08df8fe11745d5a2751), [vllm-mlx](https://github.com/waybarrios/vllm-mlx/tree/80e7fdec7e8641c8f81b01ece2d7cc256348b76f).

## Per-project findings and provenance

### BaseRT

A separately benchmarkable engine with public tooling and integration materials.

**Limitations:** The Apache-licensed repository does not make the inference engine open source; inspect license boundaries before reuse and do not claim access to its kernels.

**License review:** Apache-2.0 covers surrounding tools; core inference engine is proprietary.

### dflash-mlx

DFlash draft/verify adapter plus server, recurrent tape-replay rollback, hot/cold prefix snapshots and verification-specialized kernels.

**Limitations:** Greedy target verification is not identical to stochastic exact sampling; dispatch differences can alter the AR path. Sparse prefill is a separate approximate feature.

**License review:** Component/model licenses and notices remain separate; no upstream implementation is copied by this survey.

### exo

Topology-aware sharding across devices, including tensor/pipeline approaches and transport-dependent placement.

**Limitations:** Capacity across Macs is not a single-Mac latency win. Link bandwidth, collective cost and failure recovery are part of the benchmark.

## Reproduction and scope

Maintenance modes (`--generate`, `--check`) require the source Git checkout and refuse to write outside an installed skill. Installed skills support queries and `--validate`. Add `--include-comparators` to include non-MLX/opaque/specialized comparison baselines; default results explicitly list excluded categories. The JSON registry is the canonical engine/method inventory. Evidence digests bind the bytes fetched during the review; offline validation checks their format and locator consistency, not the continued availability of upstream bytes. No third-party engine was installed or benchmarked, no upstream implementation is vendored, and no source's performance claim is promoted.

This separately versioned engine inventory does not repin historical sources or promote legacy benchmark claims.

```bash
python3 mlx-model-porting/scripts/inference_engine_advisor.py --workload coding-agent
python3 mlx-model-porting/scripts/inference_engine_advisor.py --validate
python3 mlx-model-porting/scripts/inference_engine_advisor.py --generate
python3 mlx-model-porting/scripts/inference_engine_advisor.py --check
```
